preconditions.description: The size of the array N must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the parent array must be equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= parent[i] < N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the parent array must be a valid index or -1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of indices from 0 to N-1.
